items.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: And my first big band was Lionel Hampton’s band you know. And it had within that band it had Clifford Brown, Art Farmer and Quincy Jones

ctx.x: Tell us some of the early bands that you played with, how you got your start professionally.

Well I started with my cousin’s big band, I mean, but first, I was born and raised in St. Petersburg, Florida. And then I went to high school, you know, the same thing, the teacher in the high school band, the teacher and stuff like that. And my cousin had a 16- piece band you know. So naturally blood is thicker than water so he let me ease in there some kind of way, you know. So after I finished high school like in St. Petersburg, I went to New York you know. And my first big band was Lionel Hampton’s band you…
but we weren’t making no money but the band sure was swinging. You understand what I’m saying?
